card.purpose: Heavy uppercase words on all board cards.

motion.name: card-state
motion.purpose: Word-card state transitions; transition:none under prefers-reduced-motion:reduce.

components.name: Setup choice
components.description: Unselected role choice, using the game-local control styles.

components.name: Selected setup choice
components.description: Paper selected-role state with inset lower edge.

components.name: Clue word field
components.description: Local word-field overrides; shared platform input defaults are not retokenized.
components.css: .ds-field {display:grid;gap:0.35rem;min-width:0;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;color:#d5e3e5;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600} .ds-field input {min-width:0;width:100%;min-height:46px;text-transform:uppercase;background:#f2e8d5;color:#07171c;border:1px solid #f2e8d5;border-radius:0.35rem} .ds-field input::placeholder {color:#52636a;text-transform:none} .ds-field input:focus-visible {outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Unknown word card
components.description: Unknown Agent card; sample text is illustrative, never a hidden ownership cue.
components.css: .ds-card {position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.2rem;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:4rem;aspect-ratio:1.35;padding:0.5rem 0.2rem;border:2px solid rgb(7 23 28 / 18%);border-radius:0.4rem;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:clamp(0.75rem,2.8vw,1rem);font-weight:800;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:0.01em;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:center;overflow-wrap:anywhere;box-shadow:0 2px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 16%);user-select:none;background:#f2e8d5;color:#07171c;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;transition:background-color 180ms ease-out,box-shadow 180ms ease-out} .ds-card:hover {box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%)} .ds-card:focus-visible {outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px;z-index:2} .ds-card:disabled {opacity:1;cursor:default} @media(min-width:700px) {.ds-card {min-height:5.5rem;aspect-ratio:1.7;padding:0.75rem 0.4rem}} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {.ds-card {transition:none}}

components.name: Active team score
components.description: Active score indicator, not an interactive control; red is the actual core team token.

components.name: Folded team details
components.description: Native disclosure keeps secondary information off the initial board surface.
components.css: .ds-details {min-width:0;border-top:1px solid #47717b;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif} .ds-details summary {min-height:44px;padding-block:0.75rem;font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:600;color:#d5e3e5;cursor:pointer} .ds-details summary:focus-visible {outline:2px solid #f2e8d5;outline-offset:2px}

narrative.northStar: Dark teal table, cream word cards
narrative.overview: Mobile-first, board-first team play: a dark teal table holds cream word cards, with saturated team colors reserved for known ownership and team identity. This records the user-pinned online/mobile word-association direction, not proprietary artwork, branding, or a new identity workshop.
keyCharacteristics: Compact scores and a prominent current clue.
Separate marking, revealing, and ending a turn.
Folded secondary information; the same palette in lobby and results.

rules.name: The Ownership Rule
rules.body: Ownership color appears on a card only for Directors, revealed cards, or the ended-game board; unknown Agent cards remain paper.

dos: Do preserve the five-column board, wrapping words and names instead of truncating them.
Do keep authorized ownership in accessible card names without visible written color labels.
Do retain native buttons, visible keyboard focus, status announcements, and reduced-motion handling.
donts: Don't reveal hidden card types through color, text, ARIA, or client-only concealment.
Don't make a card tap reveal it or replace the separate Reveal Card / End Turn actions.
Don't restyle the platform shell, import proprietary art, or substitute the shared core team palette.
